_comment: Fixed curated iteration set for the redesigned annotation pipeline. ~10 diverse segments from crowd-cast-2026-05-19-raw-segments-intrasegment-v0 spanning app x activity x duration x user. We iterate the new stage 02 on these until annotations pass the rubric (see judge.py). Unit = segment_id (the new dataset's unit). run_iteration.py filters the dataset manifest for these segment_ids to build a stage-00/01 manifest.
